title: Focus-wheel results and held validation in the common working view
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Focus-wheel comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved focus-wheel workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Inspect held outputs
manualSteps.instruction: Inspect the exact outputs and held assessment. Open the support-preview representation, then reload. Leave all decisions untouched.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the wheel workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted wheel workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted wheel workflow is listed.

steps.label: Wheel workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original wheel assignment opens with its connected review, geometry and slicing stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted wheel workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted wheel diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved wheel source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual wheel run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded wheel run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Exact outputs and original held gate
steps.summary: The common working view shows this run’s actual results and mandatory human-review hold.
steps.purpose: Compare public view with authoritative exact output and assessment identities.
steps.action: Inspect results and validation findings without approving or continuing.
steps.expected: All nineteen actual result identities and the original held assessment are visible.
steps.actual: Exact 19 working-view result identities match; original assessment is linked and blocked. Full review reason remains in the exact assessment evidence.

steps.label: Recorded nominal layer evidence in 3D
steps.summary: The shared viewer reads the exact neutral layer evidence produced by the package inspection step.
steps.purpose: Inspect actual toolpaths rather than a mesh silhouette.
steps.action: Open the recorded support-preview result representation.
steps.expected: Actual ninety-layer rotatable toolpaths, with model/support visibility controls.
steps.actual: Ninety recorded nominal layers shown in the shared 3D viewer; excluded machine setup/shutdown and required package validation are disclosed.

steps.label: Layer and category controls
steps.summary: Recorded layer evidence can be inspected at an early height with support visibility changed.
steps.purpose: Verify real shared viewer controls on actual recorded paths.
steps.action: Focus Layers, press Home then ArrowRight, and uncheck Support paths.
steps.expected: Two of ninety layers and support visibility off.
steps.actual: Layer 2 selected and supports hidden without changing artifacts or assessments.

steps.label: Reload retains exact held results
steps.summary: Reopening reconciles the same durable run without starting work or consuming review authority.
steps.purpose: Verify close/reload recovery on a terminal held engineering run.
steps.expected: Same result identities and held assessment; no replay.
